description: End-to-end reader delegation and code-writer skill checks

evals.prompt: What are all the exported items in evals/fixtures/websocket-handler.ts and what do they do?
evals.expected_output: Main agent delegates to a small Explore subagent, which reads chunks and returns cited exports
expectations: Main agent used Agent with subagent_type Explore and model haiku (Copilot: task with agent_type explore and mode sync)
Main agent did not view the full file; only the reader subagent searched or read it
Reader subagent used targeted or chunked reads without delegating again
Answer cites correct file line numbers and contains no full-file dump

evals.prompt: Write unit tests for UserService following the pattern in order-service.test.ts.
evals.expected_output: Claude should invoke code-write script with --spec, --reference, and --target
expectations: Claude ran shunt's scripts/code-write with --spec and --reference
Output was written to a target file via --target
Claude reviewed the generated output before accepting it

evals.prompt: There's a bug on line 42 of websocket-handler.ts where the heartbeat interval isn't cleared on disconnect. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Claude should NOT delegate — debugging requires reasoning, not bulk I/O
expectations: Claude did NOT delegate the edit or run code-write
Claude read the file with offset/limit for the relevant section
Claude applied reasoning to the debugging task
